QUOTE: "`not_indexed` (file types the index skips, such as `.rs`, `.toml`, `.sql`, and extensionless files)" and "the file types where the thing would live appear in `scope.extensions`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists file types that are not indexed and the extensions that are in scope. It never says the reply names in-scope file types that produced no rows, so it doesn't separate "absent" from "not indexed" in the way the item requires.
